findings.current: Extreme concentration paralyzed my brain and brought the world to a standstill.
findings.defect: The source explicitly corrects the preceding impression: it was not only the spearhead that had slowed. The assembled text omits that beat before explaining that extreme concentration stopped the world.
findings.rationale: The source says, “아니, 느려진 것은 창날뿐만이 아니다,” immediately before describing the narrator’s brain and the world as paralyzed and stopped.
findings.replacement: No—the spearhead wasn’t the only thing that had slowed. Extreme concentration paralyzed my brain and brought the world to a standstill.

findings.current: No, what stunned him was the sight of that young bastard still alive.
findings.defect: The assembled version omits that the foul metallic smell and stench of the blood and organs did not bother the Great Snow Fiend, losing a stated sensory detail and contrast before what actually stunned him.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly says the smell and stench had no effect on him, then contrasts that with his shock at the young man still being alive.
findings.replacement: But the foul metallic smell and stench filling his nose did not bother him. No, what stunned him was the sight of that young bastard still alive.

findings.current: Muyaho’s sudden ambush on the Great Snow Fiend had not been planned.
findings.defect: The source places the unplanned ambush at the last moment; the assembled sentence omits that timing.
findings.rationale: “마지막 순간” explicitly marks when the ambush happened, and the accepted baseline preserved that detail.
findings.replacement: At the last moment, Muyaho’s sudden ambush on the Great Snow Fiend had not been planned.

summary: The assembled translation is mostly faithful, but it omits a sensory detail and an explicit beat in the action, and drops the timing of Muyaho’s ambush.
